Cannot execute multiple commands at once. Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ; Provided commands: (1) cd /tmp && cat > av.html <<'EOF'
NW
EOF chromium --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --window-size=256,256 --screenshot=/tmp/avatar.png --virtual-time-budget=1500 file:///tmp/av.html 2>/dev/null; python3 -c " import struct;d=open('/tmp/avatar.png','rb').read();print('avatar',struct.unpack('>II',d[16:24]),len(d),'byte')" (2) cd /workspace/project/mf/gta6/gta6-01-kit && node cli/makefun.mjs profile --username "kebumen-dev" --picture /tmp/avatar.png --bio "Builds open-world browser games with AI agents. Made for make.fun's GTA 6 bounty." 2>&1 | tail -8
